reading.sentence: Santa Fe functions as both a workplace and a departure point within New Mexico: 41.4% of jobs here are filled from elsewhere while 37.3% of residents leave — two flows crossing in opposite directions. Average private earnings at workplaces here are $5,429 a month. 6.72% of its workers travel 60 minutes or more, against 6.8% statewide. Median rent is $1,389 against a median household income of $79,071. Observed here: labour relationships, population and age structure, housing stock, tenure and cost burden. Not observed: local capital deployment, procurement relationships.
